overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. Content primarily focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, tool releases, and academic recruitment, achieving consistently high engagement rates across all platforms.

contentThemes.description: Posts discussing research papers, methodology, and tools (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) related to detecting coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Announcements regarding grants, postdoctoral hiring, and research opportunities for PhD students.
Updates on upcoming speaking engagements and recent publications in computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing research announcements across all platforms to maximize visibility.
Include direct links to publication preprints, code repositories, or job application pages in all posts to drive off-platform conversion.
Leverage Bluesky's higher amplification rate by hosting Q&A sessions or discussion threads on research methodologies.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate overall (6.14%), driven by strong resharing/reposting behavior on publications and PhD opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Solid engagement from a niche academic audience (aoir.social instance), particularly responsive to software release announcements like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest reach (1,850 followers) with high absolute engagement counts; ideal for institutional milestones such as research grants and recruitment announcements.
